review_candidates.title: Quality specialist Telecom industry (B2/C1)
review_candidates.description: Company Description Xceed is a leading multilingual Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider in the EMEA region, operating more than 10,000 web-enabled multichannel stations. The company supports key government and commercial clients in 10 different languages, delivering inbound, outbound, back-office, helpdesk, recruitment process outsourcing, social media analysis, and infrastructure management services. Xceed has operational sites in Egypt, Morocco, Mauritius, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia, offering diverse career opportunities across multiple geographies. The organization is widely recognized for excellence in outsourcing, impact sourcing, sustainability, customer experience, and diversity, equity, and inclusion. Xceed holds multiple international certifications, including COPC, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 22301, and ISO/IEC 27001, reflecting its commitment to quality, security, and business continuity. Role Description The Quality Specialist in the Telecom industry at Xceed is responsible for monitoring, evaluating, and enhancing the quality of customer interactions and processes across telecom-related operations. This full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt includes reviewing calls and tickets, analyzing performance data, conducting audits, and providing structured feedback to ensure compliance with client and internal standards. The role involves creating and updating quality guidelines, supporting calibration sessions, and collaborating with operations, training, and management teams to drive continuous improvement. The Quality Specialist also participates in root cause analysis, recommends corrective actions, and contributes to reporting and documentation that supports service excellence and customer satisfaction. The position requires maintaining accurate records, adhering to industry regulations, and actively participating in initiatives aimed at improving the overall customer experience. Solid knowledge of telecom customer service processes, contact center workflows, and industry standards or SLAs. Excellent communication and feedback skills, with the ability to deliver constructive coaching and support calibration sessions. Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced on-site environment. Proficiency in common office and contact center tools (e.g., Excel, quality monitoring systems, CRM platforms) and comfort working with digital dashboards. Previous experience in a telecom contact

review_candidates.title: Senior Wet & Dry Design Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description MAAP is a highly professional engineering firm founded in 2015 by Engineer Ahmed Farouk and partners with extensive experience in engineering services and construction. Drawing on deep knowledge of client needs and requirements, MAAP consistently delivers engineering solutions that exceed expectations. The firm provides a full range of engineering services and is recognized for strong performance and reliability. MAAP is committed to supporting, inspiring, and guiding clients through every stage of their projects. Role Description The Senior Wet & Dry Design Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in New Cairo. This role is responsible for leading the design and development of wet and dry utility systems, including mechanical and electrical components, for a variety of engineering and construction projects. Day-to-day tasks include preparing and reviewing detailed engineering designs and drawings, coordinating CAD modeling, performing technical calculations, and ensuring compliance with relevant codes and standards. The engineer will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, support project planning and scheduling, review contractor and supplier submissions, and provide technical guidance to junior engineers. The role also involves attending site meetings, resolving design-related issues, and contributing to continuous improvement of design processes and best practices. Qualifications Strong background in Design Engineering and Product Design, with experience leading complex wet and dry utility designs. Solid foundation in Mechanical Engineering for utility systems, piping, HVAC, and related mechanical infrastructure. Knowledge of Electrical Engineering principles for power distribution, lighting, and low-voltage systems in building and infrastructure projects. Proficiency in Computer-Aided Design (CAD) tools for creating, reviewing, and updating detailed engineering drawings and models. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mechanical, Electrical, or related Engineering discipline. Relevant professional experience in engineering consulting or construction, preferably in utilities or infrastructure design. Familiarity with local and international engineering codes, standards, and best practices. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with attention to detail and quality. Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in multidisciplinary teams and mentor junior staff. Ability to work on-site in New Cairo and manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Proven experience in landscape and swimming pool projects is a strong advantage. Excellent negotiation, communication, and leadership skills.
